name: @font-previewer/app
description: A local font-to-board previewer with a deeper typography decision Studio.

scripts.build: node scripts/clean-build.mjs && npm run check && npm run test && vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && vite build --config vite.preload.config.ts && npm run audit:bundle
scripts.package:linux: npm run build && node scripts/package-linux.mjs && npm run audit:package
scripts.verify: npm run version:check && npm run build && npm run sbom && npm audit --audit-level=high
